name: Locomotion Fixtures — Odd But Loadable
_note: The other half of the story, and the half that is easy to get wrong: these assets are odd enough to be worth a word and not wrong enough to refuse. They live in their own pack precisely so the test can assert that `broken` being disabled does not take them with it — a warning that quietly costs a pack its place in the world is a rule nobody can afford to trip.
